description: Raw ChaCha20-IETF (RFC 8439) keystream bytes for representative 32-byte seeds, key=seed, nonce=12 zero bytes, initial counter=0. 128 bytes = two consecutive 64-byte blocks (counter 0 and counter 1), consumed in order with no gaps. The seed-all-zero vector's first block is byte-identical to RFC 8439 Appendix A.1 Test Vector #1 (key=0, nonce=0, counter=0), and its second block to Test Vector #2 (counter=1) -- independently confirming that this stream is a conformant, correctly counter-incrementing ChaCha20-IETF keystream. The other two vectors, seed-ascending and seed-all-ff, are project-normative, not RFC-anchored: they were produced by this repository's own effective ChaCha20 implementation (internal/cmd/vectorgen) for additional seed coverage, and no external source publishes them.
